facts.text: Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer who carries a little killer wasp, is formally hired by the party for a 100 gold fee and is with them in the Barrow Mound as a scout.
Ned pays the party 10 gold back each time they let him murder somebody, provided he can do whatever he wants with the body.
Ned offers a half-off rate of 5 gold per body for the three dead goblins in the Barrow Mound's lower corridor, which Wayman found fair; the party must hand the bodies over to collect.
The Free Goblin Society would not want their dead compatriots defiled, so giving Ned the goblin bodies means sneaking them past the goblins.
